notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
I've decided to revamp a few things, and make the leveling experience a little easier, yet harder at the same time. Here are the changes now present in the game.

Monster Cores have been updated to give more experience and value.

F Cores 125XP    -   150XP
E Cores 250XP    -   300XP
D Cores 500XP    -   600XP
C Cores 750XP     -   1200XP
B Cores 1500XP   -   2400XP
A Cores 3000XP   -   4800XP
S Cores 5000XP   -   9600XP

Getting to level 99 just got easier, but why stop there?

Max Level increased to 999
Max Stats increased to 9.999
Max HP increased to 99,999

As always Monsters Level with you, and the enemies you face will always be around the average
level of your party. Monsters kind of got harder as you got to higher levels before, but that difficulty curve now continues to increase beyond level 99. Even Bats at level 900 are nothing to laugh at. And for those that enjoy using the difficulty slider to make the game harder, I feel for you.

But thats not all....

I've included a hidden Secret Treasure in the game. And Secret Treasures need Special rewards.

The first person to find the Treasure and follow its instructions will receive a free copy of every game I ever make in the American Isekai Series. But only the First person to find it AND follow the instructions.

Good Luck to you all!!
